content.short: Frontier Wallet is a Crypto, DeFi, and NFT wallet that lets users send, store and invest in 4000+ assets.
content.description: Frontier Wallet is a non-custodial, unified wallet that lets you track, view, and manage your assets and DeFi lending positions across multiple networks from a single mobile app, without exposing your private keys. It supports operations on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Bitcoin, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, and Multichain. It natively supports multiple mobile wallet apps, including Trust Wallet, MetaMask Mobile, Fortmatic, and Coinbase Wallet, enabling smooth cross-app usage.
content.meta: Frontier Wallet is a non-custodial, unified wallet to manage assets and DeFi positions. Discover Frontier Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
